map_strategy.primary: Reuse all frozen v24 primary maps, including v24-fresh-news-source-map-final.json; no new primary neighbor map is generated by default.
map_strategy.supplement: Append a new local v25 neighbor supplement map containing only the future root-accepted receipt images; v23 source/catalog maps remain unchanged inputs.
map_strategy.collection: Clone v23-guide-image-collection-map-final40.json into a new local map, preserve all existing three groups/32 images, and append only accepted numeric-full neighbor items tied to the future receipt.
map_strategy.ordinary_catalog: Accepted neighbor thumb/model items remain supplement-catalog entries and do not enter the collection map.

stop_conditions: payload SHA/length or map overlap mismatch
existing local preparation output or v25 output/partial
loader count or guide collection binding failure
